data.notes: October 2026 in Tokyo is anchored by outdoor/circuit rock festivals, a dense Shibuya–Nakameguro club run, and high-profile jazz programming at Blue Note Tokyo.

events.title: 2026 Music Bank Global Festival in Japan
events.summary: KBS’s Music Bank Global Festival brings a large K-pop multi-artist lineup to Tokyo across two days. The official event site confirms the 2026 Japan edition.

events.title: TOKYO ISLAND 2026
events.summary: Three-day outdoor music festival at Umi-no-Mori Park with OKAMOTO’S, Kroi, BIGMAMA, Fear, and Loathing in Las Vegas, ACIDMAN, ZAZEN BOYS, KANA-BOON, flumpool and more listed by day.

events.title: RA25: Tokyo
events.summary: Resident Advisor’s 25th-anniversary world-tour stop in Tokyo features DJ MARIA., Sugar Free, DJ Healthy, Mari Sakurai and Kombé at HVEN.

events.title: agefarre 2026 - ageHa×velfarre 15th Anniversary Club Edition
events.summary: A major heritage club-culture reunion from the ageHa/velfarre universe, with Ferry Corsten, Remo-con, Rinaly, Ko Kimura, Q’HEY and long-running resident crews.

events.title: QUERICO Anniversary - Lil Louis, Kuniyuki, Youth of Roots, CHIDA, Hamish & Toby
events.summary: QUERICO’s fourth-anniversary community celebration headlined by Chicago house pioneer Lil Louis returning to Japan after 15 years, with Kuniyuki live, Youth of Roots, Hamish & Toby, CHIDA and Tokyo collectives.

events.title: SESSION 25TH ANNIVERSARY
events.summary: WOMB’s long-running SESSION marks its 25th anniversary with Bart Skils, Drunken Kong, Tommy Wada, Karibiza, Q’HEY and a three-floor techno/progressive-house program.

events.title: Joshua Redman "Words Fall Short"
events.summary: Saxophonist Joshua Redman presents his Blue Note Records project Words Fall Short with Paul Cornish, Philip Norris and Nazir Ebo across three nights at Blue Note Tokyo.

events.title: SOUNDGATE - Techno / House
events.summary: Large-scale ZEROTOKYO techno/house gathering led by Takkyu Ishino, Yoshinori Sunahara, Sekitova, Seimei b2b Carpainter, Ririko, Kotsu and more.

events.title: INTERGALACTIC: PLANETFALL
events.summary: Two-night forest camping festival in Hinode, Tokyo, with two stages, installations and a program moving through techno, breaks, psytrance, drum & bass, house and downtempo.

events.title: Butterfly Effect Special feat. Subtronics
events.summary: ZEROTOKYO’s bass-focused Butterfly Effect Special is headlined by Subtronics, with Dubscribe and multiple bass, drum & bass, hardcore and house floors.

events.title: CARTULIS - Techno / House
events.summary: London label/collective Cartulis returns to Japan for a WOMB takeover with Z@p, Unai Trotti, Junki Inoue, DSKE, CHIDA, YAMA and an announced after-hours session.

events.title: In The Family FEST 2026
events.venueName: Shibuya THE GAME / Shibuya Ongakudo / Chelsea Hotel / Star Lounge / Milkyway / Cyclone / Garret
events.summary: ZEPHYREN × SHIBUYA THE GAME’s Shibuya seven-venue circuit event focuses on loud rock, hardcore and alternative acts, with DEXCORE, JasonAndrew, Quubi, ジエメイ, マザリ and others announced in the final lineup.

events.title: HVEN INBOUND: TOKiMONSTA
events.summary: Los Angeles producer TOKiMONSTA headlines HVEN, billed as her first Japan headline show since 2019, with JAIR, AKARI, ShioriyBradshaw and M.I.O supporting.

events.title: CARTULIS
events.summary: London label, collective and party Cartulis returns to WOMB with Z@P, Unai Trotti, Junki Inoue, CHIDA, DSKE, P-YAN, RYOKEI, teppei and YAMA.

events.title: NEBULA × OTO × BLACK NOIR - Techno / Hardgroove / Hard Techno
events.summary: International hard-techno and hardgroove link-up bringing Australia’s BLACK NOIR and Vietnam’s ARCAN into a three-floor clubasia takeover with Tokyo crews.

events.title: Nero x Plasma
events.summary: Secret-location Nishi-Azabu techno/industrial night where Nero brings Milan’s cult PLASMA party to Tokyo with ANKKH, DALJAE, KAITO, samJ and MUSCLE BROTHERS.

events.title: John Talabot
events.summary: Spanish selector John Talabot returns to VENT with Abiu in Room 1 and a second-room lineup of Chihoshi, MSMS, Terax and Kurea.

events.title: Alfredo Rodriguez Band featuring Pedrito Martínez
events.summary: Cuban pianist Alfredo Rodriguez brings his band to Blue Note Tokyo with guest percussionist/vocalist Pedrito Martínez for shows built around the new album ¡Take Cover!.

events.title: BUMP OF CHICKEN TOUR 2026-2027 Ratio Clavis
events.summary: BUMP OF CHICKEN’s Ratio Clavis arena tour includes two confirmed Tokyo performances at Ariake Arena on October 27 and 28.

events.title: ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION Tour 2026 “Midage Fanclub”
events.summary: ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION mark the 20th anniversary of their album “Fanclub” with two confirmed Tokyo dates at Zepp DiverCity.

events.title: CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso: Free Spirits World Tour
events.summary: Argentinian duo CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso play their first headline show in Japan in Tokyo, with the Toyosu PIT date confirmed for October 22.

events.title: Sinland Tokyo Circuit Festival 2026
events.venueName: Midnight East / OR Miyashita Park / R Lounge
events.summary: Tokyo’s leading gay circuit weekender returns in early October with two nights of parties, international guest DJs, go-go performers, a Saturday main party at Midnight East and an afterparty at R Lounge.

events.title: Fumiya Fujii ARENA LIVE 2026 360°
events.summary: Fumiya Fujii brings his 360-degree arena production to Nippon Budokan for two Tokyo shows, backed by a full live band including Naoyuki Fujii on sax and guitar.

events.title: Yokai Bon Odori 2026
events.summary: This three-day West Tokyo festival in Tachikawa combines live performances, music concerts, DJ performances, Bon Odori, costumes, and food stalls.

events.title: La Bachata Tokyo World Congress 2026
events.summary: A multi-day bachata congress and Latin dance festival in Shibuya, with pre-parties from October 14 and the main event from October 16 to 18; confirmed artists include Eduard & Maria, Danny & Dayana, Meline & Rain, Anastasia & Jovanny, and Phong & Zoey.

events.title: THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES presents FRONT CHAPTER DECADE Tour 2026 Final
events.summary: THE SPELLBOUND and BOOM BOOM SATELLITES present the tour final for Michiyuki Kawashima’s 10th memorial live, with the Tokyo date confirmed at SGC HALL ARIAKE.

events.title: ReoNa Concert Tour 2026 “De:TOUR -静脈-”
events.summary: ReoNa’s 2026 concert tour stops at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA for a Tokyo show with doors at 17:30 and start at 18:30.

events.title: The Caribbean / Latin America Street 2026
events.summary: A free, rain-or-shine Caribbean and Latin America cultural festival at Yoyogi Park Keyaki Street, highlighting music, dance, food, drink, and fashion from the region.

events.title: clubasia THURSDAY
events.summary: A low-cost Thursday late-night house/electronica session at clubasia with illequal, L?K?O, YELLOWUHURU and FELINE (JP), running 23:00–06:00 in Shibuya.
